title: Pesare la farina
target: Metodo e fonti · calcoli su pesi e percentuali; preparazione dei prefermenti
scene: Static clear bowl of flour securely supported on a generic scale; blank LCD; no hand or pouring stream.
caption_it: La ciotola poggia sulla bilancia. Prima si tara il recipiente, poi si pesa la quantità di farina indicata nella ricetta. Il display è volutamente privo di cifre.
limits: Scena ricomposta dalla foto di PJ Hamel: bilancia resa generica, marchio e lettura rimossi. Nessuna quantità o capacità rappresentata; non è una bilancia per microdosi di lievito.
prompt: Create one clean educational coloured-pen illustration matching reference1 style. Reference2 is the real physical reference: flour in a clear bowl resting securely on a kitchen scale. Draw ONLY a whole clear glass bowl containing a modest mound of plain ivory FLOUR, supported on a generic low digital scale with terracotta weighing plate and ivory body. Simple small blank LCD, two plain buttons; remove brand and all readings. No hands, no scoop, no pouring stream, no other objects. This is a weighing setup, not a claim of a measured quantity. Warm fine brown outlines, ivory and terracotta, restrained simple matte colour washes. Flour mound gently uneven with just 3 or 4 broad soft contours, no tiny grains or dotted texture, no liquid swirls. Not CGI, no paper texture, no shiny plastic highlights. Entire bowl and scale inside transparent margin, landscape3:2. True transparent background, no backdrop, shadow, aura or glow. No words, numbers or logos.

prior_attempts.note: Smoothing the pouring stream made it look too solid; replaced with a static setup

title: Mescolare la biga per poco
target: Prefermenti · Biga · Come si fa, passaggio 1
scene: A wide shallow terracotta bowl contains a low-hydration biga being mixed briefly BY HAND. One hand gently rakes/loosely gathers the mixture with slightly spread curled fingers at the bottom of the bowl; the other hand steadies the bowl rim. Use the real mixing photo for hand contacts, but the torn rough mixture photo and reference-1 dough for the STIFF irregular hydrated clumps. A loose mass of irregular torn clumps, not a smooth kneaded ball, not wet batter, not noodles and not a mountain of dry powder. The fingers bring the rough mixture together without stretching a gluten sheet. No pouring water stream, no mixer, no spoon, no floating dough fragments. Make both hands clear and unambiguous, no crossed wrists. Bowls match the approved terracotta family.
caption_it: Le dita raccolgono brevemente farina, acqua e lievito. La biga resta a grumi irregolari: il gesto non cerca una palla liscia né una maglia sviluppata.
limits: Gesto tratto da Billy Parisi; consistenza irregolare confrontata con Rosemary Molloy e con la tavola approvata. Le dosi e la ricetta di quei siti non sono trasferite a Vulcan.

title: Mescolare il poolish
target: Prefermenti · Poolish · Come si fa, passaggio 1
scene: A single hand holds a small plain wooden spoon and stirs an ivory poolish batter inside a simple wide clear glass bowl. Second hand lightly steadies the rim if needed. Recompose the photographed jar into a bowl for a clear view of the spoon immersed in the batter and the stirring action; preserve the real spoon-to-batter contact and loose, flowing consistency. Show a single broad shallow curved stirring wake that settles back, no peak or upright dough ball, no stretching lump above the surface. Freshly mixed smooth batter with just a couple of incidental trapped air bubbles, NOT a heavily fermented foam or an exaggerated cellular sponge. Keep the bowl at most one-third to half full, no lid, no jar clasp, no countertop. Clear whole utensil-to-hand relation. Simple faint terracotta contour for the glass.
caption_it: Il cucchiaio amalgama il poolish appena miscelato fino a una pastella omogenea. La scena mostra la preparazione, non il momento in cui è pronto dopo la maturazione.
limits: Fotografia Milk and Pop ricomposta dal barattolo alla ciotola; gesto e consistenza osservati. Maturazione, proporzioni e tempi restano nel testo della guida.

title: Unire la biga all’acqua
target: Prefermenti · Biga · Come si fa, passaggio 3
scene: Draw the START of incorporating a stiff mature biga into the final dough water, using the real photograph of biga and water in a mixing bowl as the physical source. A simple CLEAR GLASS bowl contains a shallow pool of faintly cloudy water with a few soft irregular ivory pieces of biga partly submerged. Recompose the metal source bowl as transparent glass so the water level and partially immersed pieces are legible. The rough biga reference supplies the torn soft dough edges. Show damp irregular pieces, not round stones, breadcrumbs, cooked food, smooth balls, powder or foam. Water remains clearly visible between the pieces. No hands, utensils, mixer, flour, salt or oil; the figure shows the intermediate stage rather than inventing an unsupported tearing gesture. Entire bowl visible in three-quarter view with a thin terracotta contour and very spare transparent-glass highlights. No shiny rendering or dense small bubbles.
caption_it: All’inizio dell’impasto finale la biga viene spezzata nell’acqua prevista dal procedimento. I pezzi devono poi amalgamarsi: la scena non rappresenta un impasto già finito.
limits: Scena derivata dalla foto di biga e acqua di Rosemary Molloy; recipiente ricomposto in vetro per rendere leggibile il livello del liquido. Non mostra una spezzatura manuale non documentata né un impasto finito.

title: Avviare l’autolisi
target: Prefermenti · Autolisi · Come si fa, passaggio 1
scene: Show the INITIAL gentle mixing of only flour and water before an autolyse rest. A wide clear glass bowl contains ONE cohesive rough shaggy ivory mass, damp and irregular but without loose dry flour. One hand gently uses its fingers to bring the mixture together at the bottom; the other hand holds the bowl rim. Use the physical hand-to-dough and support contacts from the real mixing photograph. Unlike the stiff biga scene, this is a connected shaggy mass with broad folds and damp soft edges, not separate dry crumbs. It is not a kneaded glossy smooth ball and is not being stretched into a long ribbon. No yeast, salt, oil, ingredient ramekins, scoop, packet or ingredient icons in the scene. No dough maturity bubbles. Only flour-water mixing is represented; no clock. Entire modestly filled bowl visible, simple clean ivory areas, very restrained surface detail.
caption_it: Si riuniscono soltanto farina e acqua, fino a inumidire tutta la farina, prima del riposo di autolisi. Lievito e sale si aggiungono nei passaggi successivi della guida.
limits: Il gesto di impasto a mano deriva dalla foto di Billy Parisi e viene ricomposto per farina e acqua secondo la descrizione dell’autolisi di Maurizio Leo. Non si attribuisce alla foto originale la composizione dell’autolisi.
